reasons: Admitted on the vendor's own fetched documentation; this application has not run a live key gate against this endpoint.
The vendor's OpenAI-dialect reasoning replay contract must not be assumed for Anthropic Messages without a dialect-specific document or probe.

admission.citation: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130079 — Tencent Cloud TokenHub API documentation, retrieved 2026-09-25: one base `https://tokenhub-intl.tencentmaas.com/v1` serves OpenAI Chat Completions (`/chat/completions`), Responses (`/responses`) and Anthropic Messages (`/messages`) with the TokenHub API key; per-token billing. The International site issues its own keys (China `tokenhub.tencentmaas.com`, Singapore `tokenhub-intl.tencentmaas.com`).

outputModalities.sourceRef: WINTER DEFAULT: upstream declares no output modality for ANY model, so `text` is Winter's inference for a chat registry, NOT an upstream statement. Stamped `source: winter-default` — the `EvidenceSource` member added for exactly this — so a reader filtering evidence BY SOURCE does not get a Winter guess wearing an upstream label. See PROVENANCE.md.
